stories.title: Washington State Patrol solves 35-year-old case, identifying woman killed in I-5 crash
stories.summary: Mary Ellen “Mollie” McCullough disappeared in 1991. Advances in DNA technology and a detective's determination finally gave her family answers about what happened.

stories.title: 4 Portland schools spared from closure, 10 still at risk as PPS parents push for state help
stories.summary: Portland Public Schools has scaled back its closure plan, but families at 10 schools remain in limbo as lawmakers weigh tapping into emergency education funds.

stories.title: Portland city workers' strike enters second week as union demands higher wages
stories.summary: Portland city workers continue to strike as negotiations remain stalled. A new state law allows the striking workers to file for unemployment benefits.

stories.title: PDX airport expects more than 380,000 travelers over Thanksgiving holiday
stories.summary: The Portland International Airport is bracing for a bustling Thanksgiving, expecting over 380,000 travelers amid rising air travel and recent FAA disruptions.

stories.title: Antoinette Hatfield, a 'force of nature' in Oregon society and late senator's wife, dead at 97
stories.summary: Hatfield was a writer of cookbooks, a cultural tastemaker and a partner in politics for her husband, one of Oregon's most revered leaders.

stories.title: Salem police arrest woman for dog attack at Riverfront Park that injured jogger
stories.summary: Police arrested Jennifer Hrbek, 52, and took custody of one of the dogs involved in the attack. The other dog has not been found.

stories.title: Portland police respond to trio of shootings overnight in the central city
stories.summary: Several people were injured but there were no deaths after a flurry of shootings early Sunday morning.

stories.title: Northbound I-205 to close at Abernethy Bridge this weekend while crews move bridge deck
stories.summary: Crews will use hydraulic jacks to lift the entire northbound bridge deck and move it eight feet to one side, as part of the ongoing project to widen the bridge.

stories.title: Abernethy Bridge construction extended to fall 2026 amid $72 million cost overrun
stories.summary: The project's total cost has risen to $815 million. It was previously expected to cost $662 million and planned to be finished by the end of 2025.

stories.title: Dangerous sneaker waves, 35-foot breakers threaten Oregon Coast for second straight weekend
stories.summary: A week after a child was nearly swept away, dangerous sneaker waves and 35-foot breakers threaten the Oregon Coast once again.

stories.title: No agreement reached between Portland, city workers union; strike, mediation continue
stories.summary: Portland city workers remain on strike after mediation ends without a deal. Negotiations are set to resume Thursday, Nov. 19.

stories.title: A flight delay grounded two Hollywood stars in Eugene. Their reaction went viral.
stories.summary: Stranded in Eugene, Oregon during Friday's FAA ground stop, Daniel Kaluuya and Tyriq Withers made a local TV interview one for the internet.
